scope: Actual Android touch and injected key combinations; DOM checks for chooser and selection policies

checks.test: A second tap on the active left tool window hides it and reopening restores it
Custom searchable chooser changes the underlying standard select
Only input/output areas allow text selection
Actual touch resizes sidebar with a thin 6px divider
Scrolling outside a pressed splitter does not arm resizing
C++ class wizard writes both real files in a new nested directory
Template collisions reject without overwriting existing files
Ctrl+Space is no longer reserved for IDE completion
Native Ctrl+N opens the file/class creator
Native Ctrl+F8 toggles a breakpoint at the caret
